name: measured_20260908b
description: Physical (LeRobot-normalized) to MuJoCo Menagerie joint map anchored at read-only encoder readings of the arm posed by hand at the model zero configuration (arm straight out horizontally forward, jaws opening vertically). Exact 4096 ticks/turn scale; per-joint zero offsets from the reference; gripper keeps the legacy affine endpoint map because the model cannot represent touching jaws. 2026-09-08b: shoulder-lift, elbow and wrist-flex zeros corrected; the 2026-09-07 hand-held reference had the upper arm raised and the elbow bent. The shoulder/elbow pair is anchored by the side photo of the rest pose (both printed bars horizontal) because the board data alone is indifferent along that direction.

shoulder_pan.verification: sign carried over from the legacy contract (FK invariant match); zero from the hand-held reference; direction not yet verified physically

shoulder_lift.verification: zero from the hand-held reference; sign +1 consistent with the arm resting upper-arm-up at low ticks | 2026-09-08: zero corrected by -93.25 deg: flat-checkerboard hand-eye (board-pose scatter 23 mm, 78 px RMS) anchored by the side photo of the rest pose (upper-arm and forearm bars horizontal)

elbow_flex.verification: zero from the hand-held reference; sign +1 consistent with the forearm folded forward at high ticks | 2026-09-08: zero corrected by +81.00 deg: flat-checkerboard hand-eye (board-pose scatter 23 mm, 78 px RMS) anchored by the side photo of the rest pose (upper-arm and forearm bars horizontal)

wrist_flex.verification: zero from the hand-held reference; sign +1 consistent with the gripper pitched down at rest | 2026-09-08: zero corrected by +20.00 deg: flat-checkerboard hand-eye (board-pose scatter 23 mm, 78 px RMS) anchored by the side photo of the rest pose (upper-arm and forearm bars horizontal)

wrist_roll.verification: zero from the hand-held reference (jaws vertical, moving finger on top); sign +1 verified: user turned +94 deg by hand and the moving finger ended on top as in the sim
